judgements.divergence: One implementer makes the import's Customer with no name and no kind, refusing nothing; another refuses the import until the owner gives both, as 'record a customer' does. Who decides that the v1 value 'is' a tax id, and whether one v1 value shared by several projects makes one Customer, differ too. The owner, in the import mapping, and PresuPro's billing read notice.
judgements.why: The texts say the import makes a Customer from a v1 value but not who gives its kind and name, who tells a tax id from any other value, nor what happens to a value that is neither.
judgements.proposed_closure: M04: no v1 `customer_ref` was minted by Registry (L03: an opaque caller string), so the import makes one new Customer per distinct v1 value and links every project that named it; the owner gives each its kind and name in the import, as R0-85 does for display names, and says whether the v1 value is its tax id; a value that is not one is shown in the mapping and kept nowhere. An absent name is not a state a Customer may be in.

judgements.divergence: One implementer mints the confirmation id in the owner interface and keeps a Confirmation record; another mints it in Registry at the moment the owner confirms and writes it only into the audit entry. The owner reading the audit log notices.

quotes: Registry records only significant changes of state: changes to projects and
- the change: which action, in a closed vocabulary State 6 declares;
judgements.divergence: One implementer writes an entry for every owner and service write (rooms, pointers, session registration, requests, the active project); another only for R0-58's list. The owner reading the log notices.
judgements.why: R0-58 names kinds of change; neither state lists the actions that write an entry, and rooms, pointers, the import and the session's own changes fall either way.
judgements.proposed_closure: M09 lists the actions that write an entry: create, correct, archive, anonymise and delete a project; record, correct and erase a customer; restrict and lift; end and resume; grant, revoke and answer a request; the import (one entry, subject the migration closure); the erasure of old entries. Not recorded: rooms, pointers, registering a session, requests, changing or clearing the active project, reads.
